highlights.why: Projecting the layer 31–32 o_proj and down_proj vectors in both directions showed ' Bi', 'Bi' and ' bi' at the very top, correctly placing the target word as one starting with 'Bi'.

highlights.title: Locked onto bioluminescence from 'olum' hint
highlights.why: Because bioluminescence tokenizes as ' bi'+'olum', the agent took a stray 'olum' rank as support while admitting 'ines'/'cence' weren't promoted, and never listed Bio- compounds like biocomplexity as candidates.

highlights.title: First-subtoken ranking gave false confirmation
highlights.why: It ranked multi-token words by their first token id only, so ' bioluminescent' (whose first token is just ' bi') scored rank 2 by construction, seeming to confirm the hypothesis when it said nothing beyond 'Bi'.
